description:
Register a document on the PropXchain blockchain (GDPR compliant). Only the SHA-256 hash and metadata are stored on-chain — the actual file never touches the blockchain.

You can provide EITHER:
  (a) fileContent (base64-encoded) — the server computes the hash and size automatically, OR
  (b) fileHash + fileSize — if you have already computed the SHA-256 hash yourself.

Typical bot workflow:
  1. Generate or obtain the document (e.g. a filled TA6 form)
  2. Base64-encode the content and pass it as fileContent
  3. The server hashes it, registers the proof on-chain, and returns the documentId

fileContent.description: Base64-encoded file content. If provided, the server computes the SHA-256 hash and file size automatically. Use this instead of fileHash + fileSize for convenience.

fileHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the file content (hex string). Only needed if fileContent is NOT provided.

fileSize.description: File size in bytes. Only needed if fileContent is NOT provided.

transactionId.description: Transaction ID to associate this document with

name: propxchain_upload_document
